text:
jordan: Heads-up — noticed our per-request billing numbers diverging from model token counts for some customers. Likely cause: runtime batching merges multiple smaller requests into one physical inference and our attribution falls back to route_id which is too coarse. Anyone seen this?

priya: yeah saw spikes. Only shows up for small chat replies and embeddings. Cost per API call looks inflated.

mikko: quick note: runtime does micro-batching w/ prefix KV caching; we collapse requests with same model+quant profile but different tenants sometimes when burst routing uses shared slots. We currently tag trace with trace.batching_id but we don't carry tenant attribution to the physical batch level.

jordan: right — so in telemetry we get a single batch token with combined token_count. Our current billing lookup does first-knock tenant assignment and attributes whole batch to that tenant. Wrong.

eva: could we split at ingest by emitting per-log partial_attribution entries with per-req token deltas? That'd increase cardinality tho.

priya: idea: runtime could emit an array field in the batch trace: batch.items = [{tenant: T, request_id: R, requested_tokens: n}, ...] — then billing can explode across items. Sample: 
```json
"batch.items": [{"tenant":"acme","req":"r123","tokens":42}, {"tenant":"beta","req":"r124","tokens":8}]
```

mikko: runtime-side it's feasible but impacts perf & trace size. Alternative: keep lightweight index: batch.items_summary = [{tenant:\"acme\", tokens:42}, ...] and keep per-request request_id optional.

jordan: we should also consider privacy: don't leak tenant IDs into public telemetry if customer opted out. Need to support hashed tokens or opaque billing keys.

eva: ops-bot: deploy 2025-06-05 02:10 UTC — can we gate schema change behind feature flag for Dedicated customers?

ops-bot: deploy queued for canary. /deploy runtime-batching-summaries --canary=3% 

priya: next steps: write RFC proposing: 1) new trace field batch.items_summary (array of tenant->token), 2) runtime feature flag, 3) ingest transform to expand to per-tenant metrics without storing per-request detail, 4) privacy mode storing hashed tenant keys. I'll draft.

mikko: +1. Also add fallback for mis-routed batches: if items_summary missing, fall back to proportional split using request_size_estimates from request headers.

jordan: agree. Priya, can you own RFC? I'd volunteer to prototype runtime emit. Let's sync tomorrow 10am.
